''See also: [[Waveriders Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Waveriders are a type of [[Kameira]] of the sea, characterized by their innate ability to control the movement of water. They are utilized as mounts and have been used by the [[Am’haranai]] for centuries to facilitate rapid and quiet travel. Specifically bred for speed, these creatures skim across the tops of waves during journeys, though they are not designed to provide comfort for their riders. [[Traveling]] on a Waverider can be a physically taxing experience, often leaving passengers soaked by icy spray or exposed to harsh elements. They are capable of moving quickly across the water's surface and can be found at docks or waiting in surf. In addition to being used for transport, they can serve roles such as scouts.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Waveriders are [[Kameira]] of the sea that possess the natural ability to command the motion of water. These entities serve as mounts for the [[Am’haranai]] and are associated with the [[Mason]]. While they travel by docks, a Waverider can be found waiting at a dock to be mounted. In her thoughts, [[Shera]] imagines a hidden bay that is filled with these creatures.}}
